reader_summary.overview: There are the things that you carefully plan when it comes to an IPO -- the who (the bankers, the desired institutional investors); the what (the pricing. But then there are the things that you don't plan: like the worst financial crisis since the Great Depression... as happened before the OpenTable IPO.

key_points.text: There are the things that you carefully plan when it comes to an IPO -- the who (the bankers, the desired institutional investors).
There's even a case study about it.
And so in this episode of the a16z Podcast.
